videos.script: A booking form asks for four things. A clinic, a date, a time and a phone. {{form}} The code checks each one for dangerous characters. Angle brackets, semicolons, double hyphens. {{denylist}} And it accepts the thirty-first of November. It accepts a clinic that does not exist, and a phone with seven digits. {{accepted}} None of those contains a forbidden character. A list of bad values has to know every bad value in advance, and nobody does. {{why}} So turn the question round. Describe what is good. Four clinics. Real dates. Opening hours. Ten or eleven digits. Refuse everything else. {{allowlist}} Check it once, where the data comes in, and hand the rest of the program a value it can trust. {{boundary}} Today you watch eight tests fail against the old form, and pass against the new one. {{tests}}
